main.description: Search everywhere the caller's org keeps data at once: Habitat records the caller may read, and every search tool pear knows of the caller's connected MCP servers. Each source is a backend, searched in the background as the caller. The call waits up to timeoutMs and returns what is ready, ranked across every backend; backends still running keep going. Pass cursor to page through the mixed results, or a backend's own cursor to page through only that backend's results, waiting for it if it is still running. A backend that fails, times out, or that the caller isn't connected to is reported in backends without failing the search. Requires service-auth. Callable by any org member.

org.description: DID of the community to search.

query.description: What to search for, typically a few keywords. Required unless cursor is given.

cursor.description: A cursor from a previous response: its top-level cursor continues the mixed results, and a backend's cursor continues only that backend's. The query is then ignored.

limit.description: How many results to return in this page.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for backends before returning what is ready. With a new query, waits until every backend has answered; with the mixed cursor, until a new result is ready; with a backend's cursor, until that backend has answered. 0 returns what is ready now.

results.description: This page of results, most relevant first.

cursor.description: Continues this page's results: the mixed results, or the backend's when the request's cursor was a backend's. Omitted when there are no more, now or later.

backends.description: Every backend of the search and how it stands.

ranking.description: reranker: a reranking model scored every result against the query. fallback: there is no reranker, or it failed for some results, which are ranked by their place in their backend's own results instead.

backend.description: Id of the backend the result came from, as in backends.

kind.description: record: a Habitat record, described in record. item: a result from a connected app.

id.description: Identifies the result within its backend.

url.description: Where to open the result: the app's link for an item, the record's URI for a record.

id.description: Stable id, such as records or mcp:github/github-issues.

status.description: pending: still running. ok: answered, possibly with no results. error: failed. timeout: didn't answer within pear's backend timeout. not_connected: the caller has no usable connection to the server; they never connected, or their sign-in expired.

errorCode.description: Why the backend has no results, for any status but pending and ok. interrupted: pear restarted while the backend was running; search again.

error.description: What went wrong, safe to show.

count.description: How many results the backend returned.

elapsedMs.description: How long the backend took, once it is no longer pending.

cursor.description: Fetches this backend's results only. Omitted when it has none left to fetch.
